identity.name: Xaero Minimap × EMF Entity Icon Compatibility

goals: Retain accepted Canary 9 exactly as the user-reported external PASS baseline and exact Canary 11 as failed historical provenance, including all ten supplied row-level passes.
For Canary 12 only, retain C11's targeted frog-villager face/head composition while suppressing the profession-hat subtree for exactly florist, farmer, cleric, and mason.

Freeze every other C11 icon path and policy, including Butcher, while every unlisted entity and villager profession retains the exact C9 path; do not transfer predecessor runtime evidence to Canary 12.
scope: Reuse the existing C9 failed-upstream EMF-to-Xaero seam and canonical-frame adapter without modifying its generic selector; preserve C11 unchanged for exact fox, goat, frog, bogged, and witch, and preserve the same five exact villager eligibility and effective-path contracts before C12's bounded suppression decision.

For mynx_flora_trades:florist, minecraft:farmer, minecraft:cleric, and minecraft:mason only, keep the targeted head/nose/EMF_nose direct face base plus EMF_face and EMF_frog_eyes while intentionally excluding the mapped profession-hat subtree. Keep minecraft:butcher on C11's exact composition, including its mapped chef-hat subtree; never broaden profession matching or fall back merely because an allowlisted hat is intentionally omitted.

Preserve Bee and Rabbit's working 0.75 Xaero request-scale path and ghast/happy_ghast's 1.50 effective presentation-stage scale exactly. Preserve C9 one-retry-per-variant/resource-generation cache ownership, every other C11 composition, and Naturalist/Ribbits companion boundaries.

exclusions: Broad selector changes, wildcard entity/profession matching, whole-body icons, live model mutation, world-model scaling, and unsupported runtime claims.
Changes to Naturalist, Ribbits, upstream Xaero, Fresh Animations, EMF, ETF or other projects.
Static mob icons, copied upstream assets or classes, replacement entity rendering, networking, server behavior, and redistribution of Xaero's All Rights Reserved content.
The retired Diagnostic2 source workspace, unretained generated outputs, legacy status narratives, Test Instance Manager state, deployment ledgers, snapshots, and historical administrative matrices.
Runtime deployment, Minecraft launch, either Test Slot, accepted-baseline mutation, map-data changes, and access to the protected gameplay instance during this migration.
Dedicated-server, exhaustive all-mob, per-check Canary 3, or other runtime validation not present in the frozen evidence.
